scope: Ten public static Topic Guides; unscored teaching prompts. No app-bank or linked-product certification.
status: PASS current educational/source content; hosted browser pixels and interactions pending

front_try_outcomes: What did you put in the bag invites contents; the supplied hat/book reply gives them.
I can carry = offer; could you carry = request; put it on bench = command; huge-box reaction = exclamation.
A clarification needs to identify both the object and place; no unseen point or assumed feeling is sufficient.
retained_and_application: Useful replies answer the requested time/person/place, rather than an unrelated fact.
An offer commits the speaker to help; a request can benefit someone else. Calm commands remain commands.
Actual partner exchange, signing/AAC and source-prepared cultural/film work retain meaningful observation criteria; title now permits the five listed message turns.

front_try_outcomes: Personal drawing/building/another/neither choices remain valid.
The funny-ending reason gives specific information; because I like it restates a preference.
Six-crayon tray fits the stated single-container job; the two-capacity facts, not visual guesses, determine the practical choice.
retained_and_application: Because does not make unrelated information relevant; puzzle/bus example needs a new connection.
Bigger/better comparisons are purpose-dependent, and better is not an -er form.
Supplied Book A/B descriptions close the worked-book choice gap. Actual preferences and respectful disagreement are open, while explanation relevance is assessable.

front_try_outcomes: Puppy brings an empty bowl before Jo fills it: preceding events explain the response.
Sweeping belongs under Jobs rather than Tools.
The procedure directs actions, the water-freezing explanation describes change, and the shade opinion supplies a view and reason.
retained_and_application: Recount time order differs from grouped report information; complete comparison texts are now supplied in the check.
Narrative organisation is not reduced to a universal problem/solution rule; recounts can be imagined.
Headings, sequence, pictures and because are evidence of organisation, not exclusive genre proofs.

front_try_outcomes: Here comes repeats; a meaningful new ending such as night continues the frame.
Dog rhymes with log and fits the supplied tired-animal context; hen does not preserve rhyme.
Four steady taps persist while the two syllables of little fit in the third beat; actual model/echo is required.
retained_and_application: Day/play, tree/me, sun/run and light/bright are spoken-ending matches in ordinary Australian pronunciation.
Returning words connect lines even without rhyme; not every poem needs a tune or rhyme.
Pulse, rhythm and syllable count remain distinct, and creation/performance is not inferred from a paper selection.

front_try_outcomes: Growing starts on page6; check page number and heading.
Menu then Watering follows the explicitly supplied model.
Read aloud plays text; Back or enabled Go back returns under these model rules.
retained_and_application: Original watering-can illustration gives a visible object/name link.
Nests/page4 and Food/page6 worked model is self-contained; the separate Watering/page4 check now repeats its own contents and menu rules.
Real book/digital navigation is adult-staged and separately observed; paper rules are not device-performance evidence.

front_try_outcomes: The bag is heavy is a complete state statement; The heavy bag is a naming group in this context.
Our small class is the full naming group, planted seeds the happening, and in the garden a place detail.
The puppy rested plus a sensible where detail preserves the one main clause.
retained_and_application: Is shut/is full/is small are complete states without visible movement.
The bird sings is a complete ordered statement; the fragment sat beside the fence requires its intended participant in the recount task.
A command can omit visible you; a question can be complete; length, capital/full stop and printed verb counts are insufficient alone.

front_try_outcomes: They refers to books; We replaces Jo and I and includes the speaker.
Runs, is and thinks are verbs; tired describes the state in its supplied sentence.
Slowly/how, outside/where, today/when; small describes ducks; beside the reeds is a detail group, not a single adverb word.
retained_and_application: Child/bag and koala/library are nouns in their supplied contexts.
Water functions as a verb in watering the garden and a noun in cold water.
Supplied pronouns, thinking/being verbs, precise verbs and accurate qualities prevent position-, gender- or movement-only guessing.

front_try_outcomes: The scarf and smile visibly support a playful duck character; careful drawing is not a photograph.
Visible kitten complicates the statement that the room was empty; no name/time/hidden-frame facts are inferred.
The labelled flower identifies leaf; the staged sequence shows growth but supplies no number of days.
retained_and_application: Left/right arrow signs contribute direction missing from identical words.
Actual three-panel duck picture beside the activity distinguishes story character, real-duck information and story-time invitation.
All seven instructional raster assets were actually opened independently: five LA08 images, LA05 can and LA09 plant. They agree with the named clues/counts/labels.
Generic frame question now avoids an absent-picture reference. NMA work uses actual attributed Porter artwork with adult preparation, not invented symbols.

front_try_outcomes: Pencil is outside the stated rain/wind/cloud weather group.
Seedling is a young plant; length is how long the ribbon is, using the supplied definitions.
Route is a way to go; turn changes meaning between page action and participation time.
retained_and_application: Leaf/root/stem meanings are taught before use, and the cutaway plant genuinely shows roots.
Gate–hall–garden tracing now explicitly requires an actual adult-drawn labelled path before the response.
Shelter definition is supplied before the fresh sentence; local Country/Traditional Owners/Acknowledgement vocabulary is accurate and does not authorise a Welcome.

front_try_outcomes: Gate statement/full stop, direct question/question mark and specified excited reaction/exclamation mark fit their supplied contexts.
Sam visits Canberra on Australia Day capitalises supplied person/place/two-word holiday names; visits/on remain lower case.
I have a book. Can I read it? separates the calm statement and permission question; fresh learner pairs have open meaning criteria and explicit boundary/capital checks.
retained_and_application: Moss, Tuesday, Sam, July, Mia, Ben and Canberra are explicit names, not inferred proper-noun labels for every word.
Calm Wait here. and urgent Wait here! can both fit their stated contexts; ordinary summer need not be capitalised.
Actual reading/intonation/pauses are separately observed; not every pause requires a full stop and rising voice alone does not prove a question.

limitations: Not a blind scored-bank examination or human teacher approval.
Source image opening does not certify native HTML layout; hosted pixel review remains pending.
No source audio/video, pupil speech/gesture/rhythm, independent writing or live device use observed.
App routes checked against the published ledger and exact source query/return only; no app login/marking/save audit.
Linked worksheets/slides and whole-year verification badge are outside scope.
